questions.stem: How does the endocrine system differ from the nervous system in terms of response speed?

options.text: The endocrine system produces slower but longer-lasting responses
Both systems produce responses at the same speed
The endocrine system does not produce any measurable responses
The endocrine system produces faster responses

questions.explanation: The endocrine system produces slower responses than the nervous system because hormones must travel through the blood. However, hormonal responses tend to last longer than nervous responses.
